github_release_acceptance.target: 私有 Draft Release 分片回读后重组 SHA 与 R2/OCI 密文一致；三收据齐后才完成。

blocking_oracle.private_target_gate: An --upload run checks gh availability and reads gh repo view --json nameWithOwner,isPrivate before any runtime initialization, draft creation, or asset upload. The configured name must match exactly and isPrivate must be true.
blocking_oracle.draft_gate: After gh release create --draft and before asset upload, gh release view --json isDraft must confirm isDraft=true. Any failed, malformed, or non-draft response fails closed.
blocking_oracle.same_cipher_gate: For each GitHub candidate, both R2 and OCI receipts must have status=verified and exactly match the current unique age EncryptedObject's original SHA-256, cipher SHA-256, and age algorithm. A missing, unverified, or mismatched receipt records a failed GitHub receipt before any Release create/upload/download call.
blocking_oracle.readback_gate: The release contains only .age object files plus a manifest and parts under 1.8 GiB. Downloaded manifest raw SHA must equal the uploaded manifest; reassembled pack SHA and every archived cipher SHA must equal the local manifest before GitHub receipts become verified.
blocking_oracle.completion_boundary: RuntimeStore marks an artifact complete only after verified R2, OCI, and GitHub receipts have identical cipher SHA, original SHA, and encryption algorithm.

fixture_coverage.private_metadata: Fake gh metadata rejects public, wrong-name, and malformed repository responses; a public result stops before runtime initialization or any Release command.
fixture_coverage.draft_metadata: Fake gh metadata rejects false, missing, and malformed isDraft responses before upload.
fixture_coverage.prior_receipts: Fixtures bind every R2/OCI prerequisite field: verified state, original SHA, cipher SHA, and encryption algorithm. A mismatched R2 cipher produces R2_CIPHER_SHA_MISMATCH and only a failed GitHub receipt; the fake gh client observes no create/upload/download command.
fixture_coverage.successful_readback: A temporary fake gh client proves private repo view, Draft create/view, asset upload, download, manifest raw-hash comparison, pack reassembly, per-cipher hash verification, verified GitHub receipt, and all-three completion using the same cipher SHA as R2/OCI.
fixture_coverage.tamper_rejection: A modified downloaded part raises the asset readback hash error and cannot be treated as verified.
fixture_coverage.runtime_guard: The exact frozen --upload spelling exits 3 with BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT when recipient is absent; the fixture proves no configured data root is initialized.

github_release_acceptance.blocking_result: The SA-503 focused test passed 14/14. Related encrypted-replication/completion regression passed 34/34. The full project suite passed 177/177.

semantic_reconciliation.reason: The frozen prebuilt Release script supplied chunking, Draft creation, and pack readback, but needed minimal upstream safety adapters: no runtime write before hard guards, exact private repository/Draft readback, exact R2/OCI receipt equality before GitHub provider work, and failure receipts on a failed upload/readback. No transaction/recovery-core rewrite or SA-504 behavior was introduced.

execution_corrections: The prebuilt --upload path initialized local directories and SQLite before checking the age recipient, so a missing credential could leave runtime state. The recipient/repository/gh/private-metadata guards now precede initialization.

The prebuilt GitHub queue depended only on OCI status=verified and did not compare R2/OCI receipts to the current reusable ciphertext. Both prior receipts now must match verified status, original SHA, cipher SHA, and encryption algorithm before any Release operation.

The prebuilt command requested --draft but did not read back repository privacy, target identity, Draft state, or raw manifest identity before asset verification. Those checks now fail closed and upload/readback failure creates failed GitHub receipts rather than a completion claim.
residual_risk_and_non_claims: No real GitHub, R2, OCI, Cloudflare, account, credential, provider request, age binary invocation, ciphertext upload, remote readback/delete, data upload, Docker action, deployment, Git stage/commit/push/merge/rebase, new worktree, legacy ignored-runtime access, or destructive cleanup occurred. The gh interactions in fixtures are a temporary in-process fake client and temporary files only.

The isolated frozen command deliberately removes all provider environment values and reports BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT. It proves fail-closed command behavior, not GitHub authentication, repository privacy, token scope, Draft Release visibility, free-tier availability, asset persistence, or real remote readback.

The real Owner-authorized GitHub/R2/OCI three-copy encrypted canary remains NOT_RUN. Its prerequisites are explicit owner-approved recipient, repository, and provider configuration; it must remain separate from fixture PASS and must never expose plaintext or a private identity.

Private-Database completion synchronization, encrypted cold backup, operations/recovery, and final release gates remain unfinished in SA-504 through SA-507. No intermediate Git publication is authorized before the full Task Pack passes.

source_change.product_source_rewrite: No broad rewrite. The frozen Release pack, age encryption core, R2/OCI replication core, and three-receipt completion rule remain intact; this task adds only fail-closed target/Draft/receipt gates and their local fake-client coverage.
